create_cloudfront_signer: create a CloudFrontSigner instance with a key pair id, PEM private key, and expiration seconds
sign_cloudfront_url: sign a CloudFront URL with a canned policy that expires after the configured number of seconds
sign_cloudfront_url_with_expiry: sign a CloudFront URL with a canned policy that expires at a specific datetime
get_cloudfront_signer_from_config: get a CloudFrontSigner from a CloudFrontConfig or None if credentials are missing
handle_invalid_private_key: handle an InvalidPrivateKeyError when loading a non-RSA or malformed PEM private key
